text:
Maya K: quick handoff note — i'm taking primary at 00:00. FYI there's a noisy 5xx pattern from us-east router pool over the last 20m, spikes up to ~0.8% 5xx (SLO is 0.5%). I'm going to temporarily widen the alert window to reduce page noise while we root cause. see below for what i changed and runbook links.

IncidentBot: [INC-2026-042] Incident created: "us-east router 5xx spike" — Severity: P2 — pages triggered: 3 — https://incidents.redwood.example/INC-2026-042

Devon R: can you paste the exact alert config change? need to know for the audit and to replicate if needed. also, any customer-facing impact?

Maya K: sure — short version: customers see transient request failures to some endpoints, retries succeed. impact so far: elevated error rate, no data loss. alert change i applied in Alertmanager: threshold for rule "router_5xx_rate" from 0.5% -> 1.5% for 2h. rationale: prevent paging while we scale and probe. Link to runbook: https://wiki.redwood.example/oncall/router-5xx-runbook

Maya K: command used (Alertmanager API):
```bash
curl -X POST https://alerting.redwood.example/api/v1/override -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"alert":"router_5xx_rate","threshold":1.5,"expires":"2026-04-07T02:15:00Z","note":"temporary widen during oncall handoff INC-2026-042"}'
```

Priya S: thanks — i'm incoming at 00:00 and will take primary. i'll follow the runbook and coordinate with support for any escalations. do we need to open a ticket for affected customers?

Luis G: i'm the infra responder — i applied a suppression in Prometheus Alertmanager as well (silenced the alert id `am-silence-5643`) and annotated the alert with `hand-off: widen-threshold`. Also kicked a scaling job for the router pool: `kubectl -n routing scale deployment/us-east-router --replicas=12` (from 8).

Arjun P: i'm running quick traffic probes to see which routes fail. early signal points to a slow backend in routing v2 shard-3. plan: keep widened alert, scale routers as luis did, and enable fallback routing to us-west for the most common tenants. i'll post probe results in 5m.

IncidentBot: Silence added: `am-silence-5643` — expires 2026-04-07T02:15:00Z — reason: "hand-off temporary threshold widen"

Devon R: copying to PD/telemetry owners: please make sure we log the config change in the incident timeline. For the SLA team: note that we changed an alert threshold temporarily — we'll need a note for the postmortem.

Maya K: agreed. @Devon R, can you add an entry to the timeline? i've left a short note in the incident UI. Also, i set an auto-rollback at 02:15 UTC (2h15m from now) — manual rollback earlier if fix validated.

Devon R: done — timeline note added: "00:02 temporary threshold widen for router_5xx_rate to 1.5% while scaling and investigation; silence am-silence-5643 applied; auto-rollback 02:15 UTC."

Priya S: confirmed incoming primary handoff. i'll monitor customer-facing dashboards for spike regressions and coordinate any support notices. plan for first 30m: watch errors, confirm fallback rates, validate that retries reduce user-visible errors.

Luis G: FYI — for audit, here's the exact alert rule name and id: `router_5xx_rate` (rule id `rule-rt-502`) and the Alertmanager silence id `am-silence-5643`. will attach the `kubectl` commands and pod scaling logs to the incident.

Arjun P: probe results: 5m ago, 12% of requests to /v2/stream hit 502 from shard-3; average latency there is +350ms. us-west fallback reduces error to 0.2%. i'll keep a tail of the per-tenant failure rates and post every 10m.

Maya K: handoff checklist for Priya (00:00):
- confirm primary/secondary (primary: Priya S, secondary: Devon R)
- verify silence `am-silence-5643` is set and auto-rollback time
- confirm scaling action completed and target pod count stable
- run quick smoke: `curl -I https://us-east.example/healthcheck` and `curl -I https://us-west.example/healthcheck`
- if customer impact > 1% of active sessions, notify support and PMs

Priya S: got it. secondary will be Devon R. i'll run the smoke after the handoff and report back in this thread.

Devon R: one more ask — please tag this thread with `slo-adjusted` and `handoff` labels in the incident tracker so we can filter later.

Maya K: tagged incident with `slo-adjusted,handoff,us-east`. also added the runbook excerpt: "When temporarily widening alert thresholds during handoff, always set an auto-rollback and log the reason in the incident timeline."

Priya S: smoke results (00:08): us-east healthcheck 200 OK but occasional 502s at 00:06-00:07. us-west 200 OK consistently. user-visible errors downstream seem within expected retry behavior. i'm keeping primary.

Luis G: note for postmortem: change was applied via API and Alertmanager silence; we'll include the exact API payloads and scaling events.

Maya K: thanks team — i'll stay available for 10 more mins while Priya fully picks up. if anything spikes, page as normal (do NOT rely on the suppression if customer impact passes the threshold).

IncidentBot: Incident INC-2026-042 — updated: participants: Maya K, Priya S, Devon R, Luis G, Arjun P — status: mitigation in progress — next check-in due 00:30 UTC.
